models.name: private_todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest identifiers for unauthenticated visitors before they sign up or log in.

Guests represent pre-authentication visitors who have not yet provided valid credentials to the system. The guest state is temporary and serves as the entry point for new users joining the private todo application.

A visitor remains a guest until they successfully complete the sign up process to create an account or successfully log in with existing credentials. Once authentication is successful, the guest transitions to a member with full access to their personal todo features.

This actor table works in conjunction with {@link private_todo_app_guest_sessions} for session tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest identifier was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest was soft-deleted. Null if the guest record is still active.

models.name: private_todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for tracking guest access before authentication.

This table records session information for unauthenticated visitors (guests) as they browse the application before signing up or logging in. Each session captures connection metadata including IP address, current URL, and referrer for analytics and security purposes.

Guest sessions are created when a visitor first accesses the application and remain active until expiration. When a guest successfully authenticates (signs up or logs in), their guest session ends and a member session begins.

foreignFields.name: private_todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description: The guest this session belongs to. {@link private_todo_app_guests.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest client connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL path the guest is accessing.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the guest navigated to the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session expires. Sessions have a finite lifetime for security purposes.

models.name: private_todo_app_members
models.description:
Member actor accounts for authenticated users of the private todo application.

This table stores member identity and authentication credentials. Each member can create and manage their own private todos, which are completely isolated from other members. The member actor has its own authentication flow with email/password credentials.

Key relationships:
- Has many {@link private_todo_app_member_sessions} for JWT session management
- Has many {@link private_todo_app_member_password_resets} for password recovery
- Has many {@link private_todo_app_todos} in the Todos domain (via user_id FK)

Account deletion is irreversible and permanently removes all associated data including todos and edit history.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for member identification and login authentication. Must be unique across all registered members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for member authentication. Stored securely using one-way hashing algorithm. Required for account creation and login verification.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name shown in the member's profile. Can be left empty or unset at any time. Only visible to the profile owner.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft-deleted (moved to trash). Null if the account is active. Used for trash functionality before permanent deletion.

models.name: private_todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens tracking member authentication state with connection metadata.

Each session represents a single login event for a member, storing the connection context
(IP address, href, referrer) for security auditing. Sessions expire based on the expired_at
timestamp and are used to validate JWT access and refresh tokens.

Sessions belong to exactly one member and provide the foundation for authentication state
management and login history tracking.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the member initiated the login session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL the member was accessing when they logged in.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The HTTP referrer header value from the login request, indicating the previous page the member came from.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session will expire. Used to validate JWT token validity and enforce session timeout policies.

models.name: private_todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens issued to members for secure password recovery and change operations.

Each token is uniquely generated and associated with a specific member account, enabling the member to reset their password through a secure verification process. Tokens have a limited validity period defined by the expiration timestamp.

The table supports the "Users can change their password" requirement by providing a secure mechanism for password recovery when members forget their credentials or wish to update their password for security reasons.

Related entity: {@link private_todo_app_members}.

foreignFields.name: private_todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who requested this password reset token. {@link private_todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token string used for secure password reset verification. Must be cryptographically random and single-use.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the token is no longer valid. Tokens should have a limited validity period for security.

models.name: private_todo_app_todos
models.description:
User's private todo items with title, description, dates, completion status, and soft-delete support for trash functionality.

Each todo belongs to a single member and contains the task details including a required title, optional description, optional start and due dates, and completion status. Todos support soft deletion through the deleted_at field, enabling trash functionality where users can view deleted todos, restore them, or permanently delete them.

When a todo is permanently deleted (removed from trash), its associated edit history entries are cascade deleted. Todos are completely private - each member can only access their own todos.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link private_todo_app_members} via user_id
- Has many {@link private_todo_app_todo_edit_histories} tracking all modifications

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo. References {@link private_todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. Required field that provides a brief summary of the task.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the todo item. Optional field for additional context or notes about the task.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo item. When sorting by start date, todos without a start date appear at the end.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo item. When sorting by due date, todos without a due date appear at the end.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo. Newly created todos are incomplete (false) by default. Users can toggle between complete and incomplete states.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Used for sorting todos by creation date.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last modified. Updated on every edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the todo is in the trash and excluded from normal todo lists. Null for active todos.

models.name: private_todo_app_todo_edit_histories
models.description:
Edit history entries that track field-level changes made to todos over time.

Each history entry captures a single edit event, recording the timestamp when the modification occurred and documenting which specific fields were altered during that change. Only fields that were actually modified during the edit are recorded; unchanged fields remain null in that entry.

This table serves as an audit trail for todo modifications, allowing users to review the complete evolution of their todo items. History entries are automatically created whenever a todo's title, description, start date, or due date is modified, and are permanently deleted when the parent todo is permanently removed from the trash.

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link private_todo_app_todos} via private_todo_app_todo_id
- Cascade deleted when parent todo is permanently deleted

foreignFields.name: private_todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the todo that was edited. {@link private_todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit was made. Used for sorting history entries from most recent to oldest.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The new title value after the edit, if the todo's title was modified during this change. Null if the title was not changed.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: The new description value after the edit, if the todo's description was modified during this change. Null if the description was not changed.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: The new start date value after the edit, if the todo's start date was modified during this change. Null if the start date was not changed.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: The new due date value after the edit, if the todo's due date was modified during this change. Null if the due date was not changed.
